subject.title: refactor(config): declarative doctor alias-migration DSL with inheritance-aware account seeding

question: Should `defineChannelAliasMigration` become a supported public plugin SDK API in this PR, or remain internal while the abstraction matures across more channel migrations?
rationale: The bug fix and bundled consolidation are technically separable from the permanent third-party API commitment, so repository owner intent is required.

options.title: Keep it internal first
options.body: Retain the shared implementation and Discord fix without adding a public compatibility contract until the spec shape has broader evidence.

options.title: Publish the helper now
options.body: Accept the SDK surface with explicit plugin-facing documentation and focused compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep it internal first
recommendation.body: Retain the shared implementation and Discord fix without adding a public compatibility contract until the spec shape has broader evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the immediately preceding merged migration work and have the strongest history on the affected implementation and API direction.
